Cobalt Energy (C) awarded $2.8bn multi-year government storage contract, more than doubling backlog, and raises guidance 40%. Street notes C has barely reacted in price despite the step-change in earnings visibility; several model portfolios have raised their C target to +37 lots, just below the 40-lot max, ahead of expected repricing.
